All PNGs are BGR-compatible OpenCV reads of window crop
`[1820,1030,2240,1400]` at 2240x1400 (420x370 pixels).

- `visible.png`, `hidden.png`: supplied real run-13 crops; only the two round
  minimap buttons and label strip remain when hidden.
- `visible_tab_dimmed.png`: cropped from the saved
  `datasets/albion_v2/nav_samples/tabmap_open_2.png`. The Tab overlay dims the
  parchment frame below value 75 and the arrow is unreadable; it must still
  veto recovery toggles. No game capture or input was used to make this fixture.
